# Freewebstore

> Free AI-powered eCommerce platform enabling anyone to create online stores with integrated payment processing, social commerce, and multi-channel selling.

Freewebstore is a comprehensive eCommerce solution that combines store building, payment processing, and omnichannel selling capabilities. The platform integrates with major payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and social commerce channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Google Shopping) to help merchants reach customers across multiple touchpoints.

## Key Topics

- eCommerce Platform
- Online Store Builder
- Payment Processing
- PayPal Integration
- Stripe Integration
- Social Commerce
- Mobile-Responsive Design
- Product Sync
- Generative AI
- Payment Gateways
- Shopping Cart
- Multi-Channel Selling
- PCI Compliance
- Store Setup
- Customer Testimonials

## Core Platform

- [Create a Free Online Store or eCommerce Website](https://freewebstore.com): Homepage: Create free online stores with AI-powered features and SEO tools.
- [Online Store Builder](https://freewebstore.com/online-store.html): Free online store builder with PayPal, Stripe and WorldPay payments.
- [Feature Packed Ecommerce Solution](https://freewebstore.com/features.html): Freewebstore eCommerce features: AI, mobile-responsive design, customization.

## Payment Processing & Checkout

- [Shopping Cart](https://freewebstore.com/shoppingcart.html): Secure shopping cart with payment gateways: Visa, Mastercard, PayPal.
- [PayPal Integration](https://freewebstore.com/paypal.html): PayPal Commerce Platform integration for Freewebstore checkout.
- [Stripe Integration](https://freewebstore.com/stripe.html): Stripe payment gateway integration with fraud protection for stores.
- [Partners & Payment Methods](https://freewebstore.com/partners.html): Freewebstore partners: PayPal, Stripe, Ryft and payment integrations.

## Social Commerce & Multi-Channel Selling

- [Sell on Facebook & Instagram](https://freewebstore.com/facebook_instagram.html): Sell on Facebook and Instagram shops with product sync.
- [Sell on TikTok](https://freewebstore.com/partners/shopping/tiktok/tiktok.html): TikTok integration: sync catalog and reach 1B+ monthly active users.
- [Sell on Google Shopping](https://freewebstore.com/google.html): Google Shopping integration to upload and sell products.
- [Sell on Pinterest](https://freewebstore.com/pinterest.html): Pinterest Shop integration with product catalog sync.

## Business Tools & Integrations

- [KashFlow Accounting Integration](https://freewebstore.com/partners/accounting/kashflow/kashflow.html): KashFlow accounting integration for UK small business VAT reporting.

## Social Proof & Case Studies

- [Case Studies and Testimonials](https://freewebstore.com/stores.html): Case studies and testimonials from Freewebstore store owners.
